description: Find consultant assignments by keyword, skills, role and location, then view assignment details and links. Create email alerts with confirmation by email. Connect your Consultant.dev account and accept AI processing to upload a CV, view personalized assignment matches and refresh matching. Uploading a CV can replace your saved CV and update your profile. Matching may send notifications according to your account preferences. Match refresh limits are reported with the next available refresh time.
